mapper.sql: o.opp_id,o.opp_nm,o.cust_clnt_id,c.clnt_nm AS customer_name,o.part_id,o.sales_step_cd, o.win_prbl_rt,o.prbl_manual_yn,o.expct_amt,o.ctrt_type_cd,o.bgn_plan_ym,o.expct_prd_mcnt::int, o.work_plc_addr,o.work_area_cd, (SELECT concat_ws(' ',wa.sido_nm,wa.sgg_nm,wa.emd_nm) FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA wa WHERE wa.area_cd=o.work_area_cd) AS work_area_name, o.next_todo_cn,o.next_todo_ddln_dt,o.rmrk,o.opp_stat_cd,o.expct_prft_rt, o.aprv_stat_cd,o.aprv_prft_rt,o.rslt_dt,o.lose_rsn_cd,o.lose_memo,o.proj_id,o.reg_user_id, COALESCE(o.mod_dttm,o.reg_dttm) AS modified_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SL_OPP o LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.clnt_id=o.cust_clnt_id WHERE o.opp_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_SL_OPP o LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.clnt_id=o.cust_clnt_id WHERE o.opp_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF o
SELECT n.need_sn::int,n.job_cd,n.grade_cd,n.need_cnt::int,n.bgn_ym,n.prd_mcnt::int,n.mon_mm,n.expct_uprc FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n WHERE n.opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY n.need_sn
SELECT h.aprv_act_cd,h.reg_dttm,h.act_rsn FROM TB_SL_APRV_HIST h WHERE h.opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.hist_sn DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT t.tent_id::bigint,t.opp_id,o.opp_nm,t.need_sn::int,t.dev_id,t.bgn_ym,t.tent_stat_cd FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.opp_id=#{id} AND t.tent_stat_cd IN ('ACT','CNVT') ORDER BY t.tent_id
WHERE t.dev_id=#{developerId} AND t.tent_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY t.opp_id,t.need_sn,t.tent_id
WHERE t.dev_id=#{developerId} AND t.tent_stat_cd='CNVT' ORDER BY t.tent_id
SELECT SUM(n.need_cnt*n.mon_mm*n.prd_mcnt) FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n WHERE n.opp_id=#{id} GROUP BY n.job_cd ORDER BY n.job_cd
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_CLNT c WHERE c.clnt_id=#{id} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.part_id=#{id} AND p.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA a WHERE a.area_cd=#{code} AND a.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} AND d.use_yn='Y')
SELECT CASE WHEN j.add_val2 ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(j.add_val2 AS numeric) END FROM TB_SY_CODE j WHERE j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=#{jobCode} AND j.use_yn='Y' AND j.del_yn='N'

WITH people AS ( SELECT d.dev_id,d.job_cd,d.grade_cd,SUM(c.labor_alloc_amt+c.team_exps_amt+c.proj_exps_amt) AS cost FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY p JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id=p.dev_id JOIN TB_CO_MON_COST c ON c.dev_id=p.dev_id AND c.cost_ym=p.pay_ym
WHERE p.pay_ym=(SELECT MAX(m.pay_ym) FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CO_MON_COST k WHERE k.cost_ym=m.pay_ym)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.work_stat_cd='LEAVE' AND s.bgn_dt <= (to_date(p.pay_ym,'YYYYMM')+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date AND (s.end_dt IS NULL OR s.end_dt >= to_date(p.pay_ym,'YYYYMM'))) GROUP BY d.dev_id,d.job_cd,d.grade_cd ) SELECT round((CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.job_cd=#{jobCode}) >= 2 OR true THEN AVG(p.cost) FILTER(WHERE p.job_cd=#{jobCode}) ELSE AVG(p.cost) END)/10000)*10000 FROM people p p.grade_cd=#{gradeCode}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substring(o.opp_id FROM 3) AS integer)),0)+1 FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE o.opp_id ~ '^O-[0-9]{4}$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SL_OPP(opp_id,opp_nm,cust_clnt_id,part_id,sales_step_cd,win_prbl_rt,prbl_manual_yn, expct_amt,ctrt_type_cd,bgn_plan_ym,expct_prd_mcnt,work_plc_addr,work_area_cd,next_todo_cn,next_todo_ddln_dt,rmrk, opp_stat_cd,expct_prft_rt,aprv_stat_cd,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_user_id,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{id},#{input.opportunityName},#{input.customerId},#{input.salesPartId},#{input.stageCode}, #{input.winningProbability},#{manualYn},#{input.expectedAmount},#{input.contractTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, replace(#{input.startMonth},'-',''),#{input.expectedMonths},#{input.workplace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.workAreaCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{input.nextAction,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{input.nextActionDueDate,jdbcType=DATE},#{input.memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ING',#{profit},#{approval},#{actor},clock_timestamp(),#{actor},clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT PK_TB_SL_OPP DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t WHERE t.opp_id=#{id} AND t.need_sn=#{needSn} AND t.tent_stat_cd NOT IN ('ACT','REL')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn} AND tent_stat_cd='REL'
DELETE FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET tent_stat_cd='REL',proc_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_user_id=#{actor} WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET tent_stat_cd='REL',proc_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_user_id=#{actor} WHERE tent_id=#{tentativeId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET tent_stat_cd='REL',proc_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_user_id=#{actor} WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
mapper.insert: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET bgn_ym=replace(#{startMonth},'-',''),mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn} AND dev_id=#{developerId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT' RETURNING tent_id ) INSERT INTO TB_SL_TENT_ASGN(opp_id,need_sn,dev_id,bgn_ym,tent_stat_cd,src_scrn_id,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) SELECT #{id},#{needSn},#{developerId},replace(#{startMonth},'-',''),'ACT','UI-29',#{actor},clock_timestamp() WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SL_OPP SET aprv_stat_cd=#{status},aprv_prft_rt=CASE WHEN #{status}='OK' THEN #{profit} ELSE aprv_prft_rt END, mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE opp_id=#{id}

WITH expired AS (UPDATE TB_SL_RCMD_LOG SET SCORE_DTL=replace(SCORE_DTL,'"e":true','"e":false') WHERE OPP_ID=#{id} AND USER_ACT_CD='EXCL' AND SCORE_DTL LIKE '%"e":true%')
UPDATE TB_SL_OPP SET opp_stat_cd=#{status},rslt_dt=#{date,jdbcType=DATE},lose_rsn_cd=#{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lose_memo=#{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE opp_id=#{id}

WITH linked AS (UPDATE TB_PJ_PROJ SET opp_id=#{id},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}), expired AS (UPDATE TB_SL_RCMD_LOG SET SCORE_DTL=replace(SCORE_DTL,'"e":true','"e":false') WHERE OPP_ID=#{id} AND USER_ACT_CD='EXCL' AND SCORE_DTL LIKE '%"e":true%') UPDATE TB_SL_OPP SET opp_stat_cd='WIN',proj_id=#{projectId},rslt_dt=#{date},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE opp_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN(proj_id,job_cd,plan_mm,src_cd,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) SELECT #{projectId},n.job_cd,SUM(n.need_cnt*n.mon_mm*n.prd_mcnt),'OPP',#{actor},clock_timestamp() FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n WHERE n.opp_id=#{id} GROUP BY n.job_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SL_TENT_ASGN SET tent_stat_cd='CNVT',proc_dttm=clock_timestamp(),mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=clock_timestamp() WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
